emergency.condition_text: another seat is assembling a loop or a one-turn kill, and your answers are a handful of instants
indications: A seat tutors twice in one turn, or plays a piece and holds its mana up.
A seat whose deck checks at bracket 4 sits across from your bracket 3 list. Games 002 and 006 both ended on Ryan's Teval going infinite, the second around turn 8 or 9 (log:002, log:006).
A sacrifice outlet and a recursion piece sit on one board, or a seat's graveyard is the engine.
A seat's life total, token count or land count jumps on a turn it attacks nobody.
You have the engine running and the kill is one card short. In 006 every multiplier and 36 Treasure were on the board and no wheel came (log:006).
immediate: Name the piece already on the battlefield that the loop needs. That piece is the target.

Answer it at instant speed: Swords to Plowshares ({W}) or Get Lost ({1}{W}) on a creature, Get Lost on an enchantment, Prismari Command ({1}{U}{R}) on an artifact, Chaos Warp ({2}{R}) on any permanent, Otawara's channel to bounce it, or Teferi, Master of Time's -3 to phase a creature out for a turn.
If the last piece is a noncreature spell from hand, hold {U} for Stubborn Denial or {1}{U} for Negate through that seat's turn and counter it.

If nothing answers it, count your own kill for this turn: 21 from one commander at one seat, the Needlehead wheel (stack 011, 21 per seat), or the Sphinx wheel (stack 009). If it is there, take it now, and if it is one seat short, kill the combo seat.
subsequent: From the turn a seat shows its first piece, keep {W} and {1}{U} open before you tap out for a commander, Equipment or an enchantment.

Turn banked Treasure into cards on that seat's turn, not yours: cycle Shark Typhoon, activate Faerie Mastermind ({3}{U}) or Gleaming Splendor ({2}{W}), cast Heartwarming Redemption or Tolarian Winds. You are digging for the answer or the last kill piece.
Cast Grand Abolisher before your kill turn. On your turn no opponent casts a spell or activates an artifact, creature or enchantment ability, so a combo piece cannot answer your swing.
Do not wheel a graveyard deck. A symmetrical wheel or Collective Defiance's first mode fills its graveyard and refills its hand.
While the combo seat is short a piece, do not cast Prosperity or activate Faerie Mastermind: each hands that seat a card.
emergency.notes: Your answers stop permanents, not a graveyard: nothing in the 99 exiles a graveyard. Against a loop that returns pieces from the yard, hit the outlet or the engine on the battlefield, or race it. Teval, Ryan's commander, works from his graveyard, so every card a wheel makes him discard is fuel. Both grounding games predate v2.3.0: 002 was on v1.3.0 and 006 on v2.2.0 (log:002, log:006).

emergency.condition_text: a seat's board or engine will kill you before your commander reaches 21, and you cannot block it
indications: A seat warps or casts big hasty creatures every turn. Alex's Tannuk warp deck outpaced the list in 004 (log:004).
A seat's enchantment or creature pings the whole table as its creatures enter. Purphoros under Goblin Storm drained the table in 005 before the commanders arrived (log:005).
Turn five with no commander on the battlefield. Game 003 read 'slow to get cards out' (log:003).
You are casting small creatures and loots while both commanders sit in the command zone (log:005).
A seat's attack takes a third or more of your life in one swing.
immediate: Count both clocks aloud: how many of their turns kill you, and how many of yours kill them.

If theirs is shorter, answer the engine, not the bodies: Tannuk or a pinger creature with Swords to Plowshares, Get Lost or Chaos Warp at the end of the turn before theirs; the artifact that ends his turn with Chaos Warp, Prismari Command or Otawara in his main phase after he spends the warp mana; an enchantment with Get Lost or Chaos Warp.

If the board is many small creatures, cast Incendiary Command ({3}{R}{R}) in your main phase: 2 damage to each creature plus 4 to the racing seat. Count your own creatures with toughness 2 or less before you cast it.
Cast a commander this turn if one is castable, ahead of any other creature. Brallin with a red source, otherwise Shabraz.

On their turn, in their beginning of combat, cycle Shark Typhoon with every land you held open: a flying X/X Shark that blocks this turn, and the cycle pays Brallin a counter and a ping and Shabraz a counter and a life.
subsequent: Point every point of commander damage at the racing seat until it is gone.
Go over the board, not through it. Shabraz flies, Shabraz's {W/U} gives Brallin flying, Brotherhood Regalia makes the carrier unblockable, and Zirda's {1},{T} stops one blocker.
Cast Akroma's Will in combat on your swing with both modes chosen: double strike, flying and lifelink on every creature you control.

Fire the wheel on the turn it closes the gap, not before: Wheel of Fortune under Razorkin Needlehead and Torbran is 21 per seat (stack 011); under Needlehead and Brallin from a four-card hand, 10 (stack 014).
Leave Bard, King of Dale untapped on their turn: reach and vigilance make it a flyer blocker after it attacks.
emergency.notes: Brallin's, Glint-Horn's and Needlehead's damage hits players, never creatures, and Needlehead has first strike only on your turn, so none of them blocks well. Grand Abolisher and Negate do nothing against a warped creature or the turn-ending artifact activated on Alex's turn. Hold Chaos Warp at Alex's table: it answers Tannuk or the turn-ending artifact. All three games predate v2.3.0; 004 and 005 were on v2.2.0 (log:003, log:004, log:005).

emergency.condition_text: the engine is running and the finisher has not come: no wheel, or no commander, and the window is closing
indications: Turn five with lands, rocks and loots out and no commander cast. In 004 both commanders were held for a wheel that never came (log:004).
Treasure is piling up and the hand is empty. 006 ended with 36 Treasure and no cards (log:006).
You have dug five or more cards past a multiplier and found no wheel. In 006 the first wheel sat deep in the library (log:006).
You are spending mana on small creatures while the commanders sit in the command zone (log:005).
immediate: Cast a commander this turn if none is out. The play rule since 004: the first commander goes down on curve, not after a wheel (log:004).

Turn spare mana and Treasure into cards: Mind Spring for X, Rush of Knowledge with a six-mana permanent out (Bard, Consecrated Sphinx, Fiery Emancipation, or a cast Shark Typhoon), Gleaming Splendor targeting yourself and an opponent. Cast Prosperity only with Consecrated Sphinx, Razorkin Needlehead, Smothering Tithe or Faerie Mastermind on the battlefield.

If Idyllic Tutor is in hand and Treasure is banked, fetch Shark Typhoon and cycle it for the largest X you can pay: a flying X/X Shark, and Brallin's {R} gives it trample because it is a Shark. This is the line the pilot planned in 006 (log:006).
Close without a wheel: put Blade Historian down or hold Akroma's Will, attach Brotherhood Regalia, and count 21 per commander per seat.
subsequent: Loot every turn: Kitsa's tap, Teferi, Master of Time's +1 on another seat's turn, Faithless Looting, Cathartic Reunion. Each discard is a counter and a ping on Brallin, each draw a counter and a life on Shabraz.
Cast Heartwarming Redemption or Tolarian Winds at the end of the turn before yours when the hand holds no play. Both are instants and wheel only your hand.
Flash back Shattered Perception ({5}{R}) from the graveyard when Treasure is banked and the hand is dead.
Keep one wheel in hand from the moment you find it, and spend the others as card flow only when the hand holds no play.
emergency.notes: The draw engine that dug in 006 has since been rebuilt; v2.3.0 added Mind Spring, Rush of Knowledge, Prosperity, Gleaming Splendor and four wheels so that Treasure has somewhere to go. Idyllic Tutor finds an enchantment and never a wheel. Games 004 and 006 are logged as raced and combo; they are cited here because the log describes the stall that led there (log:004, log:005, log:006).

emergency.condition_text: the mana has stopped short of a commander, or the colour it needs is not there
indications: Three lands on turn four with no rock.
Four mana and no red source: Brallin, Torbran ({1}{R}{R}{R}) and Gratuitous Violence ({2}{R}{R}{R}) sit in hand.
Game 003 was 'mana starved one round' and 'slow to get cards out' (log:003).
In game 001 the only fast mana was Sol Ring in the opener and nothing followed it (log:001).
immediate: If you hold no land, dig before the land drop: Faithless Looting ({R}), Kitsa's tap, Cathartic Reunion ({1}{R}, discard two spells), cycling Shark Typhoon for X=0 ({1}{U}), Marauding Mako ({2}) or Raugrin Triome ({3}), or sacrificing Mind Stone or Fiery Islet for {1}. Discard spells, keep lands.

Play the land that casts something this turn. Training Center and Sea of Clouds enter untapped with two or more opponents. Crack a fetch for the colour you are missing: Arid Mesa, Flooded Strand, Polluted Delta and Scalding Tarn find the shock lands, Raugrin Triome and the Mountain.
Cast the cheapest rock before any other spell: Sol Ring, then Arcane Signet, Izzet Signet or Talisman of Creativity if red is missing, Azorius Signet or Talisman of Progress if white or blue is.
With no red source, plan Shabraz ({3}{W}{U}) as the first commander and pass on Brallin's turn.
subsequent: Cast Smothering Tithe before a symmetrical wheel or Prosperity: every card an opponent draws and does not pay {2} for is a Treasure.
Put Xorn down before the Treasure turn; it adds one Treasure to each batch.
Cast Prismari Command at the end of the turn before yours choosing a Treasure and the loot on yourself.
Activate Gleaming Splendor on an opponent's turn after their draw step, targeting yourself and that opponent: that is their second card this turn, so it makes a Treasure.
Spend Treasure on a commander before you spend it on cards.
emergency.notes: Red is the colour that runs short on this list; the Limitations page carries the source count. Both grounding games predate v2.3.0, whose land pass added four fetches, Exotic Orchard and Ferrous Lake (log:001, log:003).

emergency.condition_text: a removal spell or ability is pointed at Shabraz or Brallin, and that commander's tax is about to go up by two
indications: A seat passes with {W}, {B} or {1}{U} open the turn after a commander lands.
A commander is on the battlefield with no Lightning Greaves or Brotherhood Regalia on it.
The table has already answered one commander. In 001 Brallin was removed twice and the tax came on (log:001).
The commander carries counters. The table reads counters as the kill.
immediate: Read the removal: does it target, is it a spell or an ability, and does it destroy, deal damage, exile or bounce.
If it targets, cast Deflecting Swat for free (you control a commander) and move it to one of their permanents, or cast Loran's Escape ({W}): hexproof makes it lose its target.
If it is a noncreature spell and step 2 did not stop it, counter it: Stubborn Denial ({U}, a hard counter with a creature of power 4 or more) or Negate ({1}{U}).

If it destroys or deals damage, cast Flawless Maneuver for free. If it exiles, channel Otawara, Soaring City ({3}{U}, one less per legendary creature you control) on your own commander: it returns to your hand and you recast it with no tax.
If nothing answers it, put the commander in the command zone and say the new tax aloud: Brallin 4, then 6, then 8; Shabraz 5, then 7, then 9.
subsequent: Recast with Lightning Greaves already on the battlefield and equip it for {0} the turn the commander lands: haste and shroud make the cast turn an attack turn.
If one commander has been removed twice, cast the other. Brotherhood Regalia moves to any legend for {1}.
Keep Flawless Maneuver and Deflecting Swat in hand from here on. Both are free only while you control a commander; on a turn both are in the command zone they cost full price.
Under Zirda, Otawara's channel costs two less, never below one mana.
emergency.notes: Lightning Greaves gives shroud, and shroud stops YOUR targeting too. With Greaves on a commander you cannot equip Brotherhood Regalia to it, cast Loran's Escape on it, channel Otawara on it, or have the commanders hand each other flying or trample. Equip Regalia first and Greaves last, and move Greaves off on the turn you need a targeted save. Game 001 was played on v1.2.0 (log:001).

emergency.condition_text: a sweeper is coming or has landed, and a commander is on the board
indications: A white or black seat passes with four or more mana open and a board behind yours.
Both commanders are on the battlefield with counters, plus Needlehead, Glint-Horn or Psychosis Crawler beside them.
A seat with a sweeper in its colours has drawn a fresh hand from your wheel.
The pod has already wiped once this game. In 006 the deck stayed alive through several wraths and wipes (log:006).
immediate: Read the sweeper: destroy, damage, exile, bounce or -X/-X.
If it is a spell, counter it: Stubborn Denial ({U}, hard with a 4-power creature) or Negate ({1}{U}).

Against destroy, cast Flawless Maneuver for free (you control a commander). Against damage from a coloured source, Akroma's Will's second mode ({3}{W}) gives indestructible and protection from each colour.
Against exile or -X/-X, channel Otawara on the commander with the most counters and recast it from hand later with no tax.
Let the rest resolve. A commander that dies or is exiled goes to the command zone; say the new tax aloud.
subsequent: Recast one commander, not both. Keep the second in the command zone as the next rebuild.
At the end of the turn before yours, cycle Shark Typhoon with every land left open for a flying X/X Shark. It is an ability, so a counterspell does not stop it.
Equipment and rocks survive a creature sweeper. Re-equip on the commander you recast: Brotherhood Regalia {1}, Lightning Greaves {0}, Greaves last.
Hold Razorkin Needlehead and Psychosis Crawler in hand until the turn a wheel or a big draw follows them.
Before your next creature, count the sweeper seat's open mana again.
emergency.notes: Grand Abolisher stops spells only on your turn, so it never stops a sweeper cast on theirs. Teferi, Master of Time's -3 phases only a creature you do not control, so it saves nothing of yours. Game 006 survived its wipes on v2.2.0, which carried two phase-out cards v2.3.0 cut; on this list the answers to an exile or -X/-X sweeper are a counterspell and Otawara (log:006).

emergency.condition_text: the table has turned on the wheels or the Tithe, and you have become the problem
indications: A seat complains when you cast a wheel. The table split on them in 001: 'people either loved it or hated it' (log:001).
You have wheeled twice before any commander is big. In 002 the pilot named repeated discards as the thing the table did not enjoy (log:002).
Opponents start paying {2} for every Smothering Tithe trigger and {1} for every Rhystic Study trigger.
Removal starts coming at you before your board is the largest one.
immediate: Stop casting symmetrical wheels for card flow. Loot instead: Kitsa, Teferi, Master of Time's +1, Faithless Looting, Cathartic Reunion, Shark Typhoon's cycling.

When you need a refill, cast a one-sided one: Tolarian Winds, Shattered Perception, Heartwarming Redemption, Borrowed Knowledge's second mode, Fateful Showdown, or draw with Mind Spring and Rush of Knowledge.
Save the next symmetrical wheel for the turn it ends a game or puts a commander within one swing of 21 (log:002).
Spend your next removal spell on the seat that is ahead, and say so at the table.
subsequent: Name Brallin's pings before you loot. They hit every opponent; do not promise a seat a pass you break with your next discard.
Keep Razorkin Needlehead in hand. On the battlefield it tells the table your next wheel hits every seat, and draws the removal before the wheel.
Cast Consecrated Sphinx on the turn before the wheel, not earlier. It is the board of stack 009, and the table aims the next removal at it.
Offer an answer for another seat's problem in exchange for a turn without removal aimed at you. Swords to Plowshares and Get Lost are the cards to offer.
emergency.notes: A symmetrical wheel or Prosperity refills a seat with an empty hand. When one seat holds zero or one card, cast a one-sided wheel instead of Wheel of Fortune or Windfall. Gleaming Splendor's activation hands an opponent a card too; target the seat that is behind (log:001, log:002).

keep: Three to five lands, or two lands and Sol Ring or a two-mana rock: Arcane Signet, Azorius Signet, Izzet Signet, Talisman of Creativity, Talisman of Progress, Mind Stone, Thought Vessel.
A play for turn two or three: a rock, Kitsa, Faerie Mastermind, Gleaming Splendor, Rhystic Study, Cathartic Reunion, Rielle, Zirda or Xorn.
A red source or a rock that makes red, so Brallin is castable on turn four; otherwise white and blue for Shabraz.
A land-and-ramp hand with no payoff is a keep: the commander and the loots dig to the payoff (Q012, log:004).
At most one wheel. A wheel is a payoff, not a play (log:002, log:005).
ship: Two or more wheels with nothing to cast before turn four. That was the hand the pilot doubted in 002 (log:002).
No red source and no white-blue pair: neither commander is castable.
A hand of cards that need a commander first: Blade Historian, Akroma's Will, Torbran, Gratuitous Violence, Fiery Emancipation and wheels, with no early plays.
preflight.note: In a multiplayer game the first mulligan does not cost a card. Gemstone Caverns goes onto the battlefield before turn one only if you are not the starting player; in 004 the pilot went first and it made only colourless (log:004). When it does go down, exile a wheel or a payoff, never a rock or a land.

steps: Turn one: land, then Sol Ring if you have it, otherwise Marauding Mako. Hold Faithless Looting unless you are short a land drop; once Brallin is out it pays him twice.
Turn two: a two-mana rock. With no rock, Kitsa or Gleaming Splendor; hold Faerie Mastermind and flash it in at the end of an opponent's turn.
Turn three: Rhystic Study, Rielle, Zirda, Xorn, Lae'zel or a second rock. With Sol Ring on turn one, Brallin.
Cast Cathartic Reunion on turn three only with two cards in hand you will not miss.
Keep Razorkin Needlehead and Psychosis Crawler in hand. Each comes down the turn before, or the turn of, a wheel or a big draw.
Cast no wheel in the first three turns.
Spend Swords to Plowshares or Get Lost in the first three turns only on a creature that kills a commander on sight, Tannuk, or a combo piece.
First commander on curve, never held for a wheel (log:004). Brallin on turn four with a red source. Shabraz first if Rhystic Study, Teferi's Ageless Insight or Bard is out, or if red is missing.
Protection on that commander the turn it lands: Brotherhood Regalia ({1} on a legend, ward {2}, unblockable) first, Lightning Greaves ({0}) last. Keep Flawless Maneuver and Deflecting Swat in hand.

The conversion piece for that commander. Brallin: Torbran, Gratuitous Violence, Fiery Emancipation, Glint-Horn Buccaneer. Shabraz: Teferi's Ageless Insight, Bard, King of Dale, Psychosis Crawler, Consecrated Sphinx. Either: Lae'zel.
Feed it every turn. Loot with Kitsa, Teferi, Master of Time, Faithless Looting or Cathartic Reunion; turn spare mana into cards with Mind Spring or Rush of Knowledge.
The Treasure wing once a commander is protected: Smothering Tithe, then Xorn or Zirda. Activate Gleaming Splendor ({W} under Zirda) on opponents' turns.
Second commander when the first is protected and the mana is spare.

The wheel last, on the turn you swing (log:002). With Needlehead, Sphinx, Tithe or Splendor out, cast a symmetrical wheel: Wheel of Fortune, Windfall, Reforge the Soul, Magus of the Wheel, Jace's Archivist, Incendiary Command. Otherwise a one-sided one. Stack 014: Wheel of Fortune with Brallin and Needlehead out and three other cards in hand is 10 per seat.
Untap. Count each opponent's open mana and colours before you cast anything.
Main phase: loot with Kitsa, cast Faithless Looting, Mind Spring or Rush of Knowledge. Each draw is a counter on Shabraz, each discard a counter on Brallin and a ping at every opponent.
Equip at sorcery speed, Brotherhood Regalia before Lightning Greaves.
Give the attacker evasion: Shabraz's {W/U} gives Brallin flying, Brallin's {R} gives Shabraz or a Shark token trample, Zirda's {1},{T} stops one blocker. Attack.
Pass with Flawless Maneuver or Deflecting Swat in hand, and {W} for Swords to Plowshares or Loran's Escape, or {U} for Stubborn Denial.

On opponents' turns spend what you held: Teferi, Master of Time's +1, Faerie Mastermind's {3}{U}, Gleaming Splendor after that seat's draw step, and Shark Typhoon's cycling at the end of the turn before yours.
Count commander damage per commander per seat: 21 from Shabraz, or 21 from Brallin, at one player. The two do not add together.

Count the size after this turn's draws. Each card drawn is +1 on Shabraz, each card discarded +1 on Brallin, and Lae'zel adds one to each placement. Bard and Teferi's Ageless Insight double every draw except the first in your draw step.
Put Grand Abolisher on the battlefield the turn before. On the kill turn no opponent casts a spell or activates an artifact, creature or enchantment ability.

Sequence the turn: draw or wheel in your first main phase, then attack. Blade Historian goes down before combat; Akroma's Will is an instant, cast after blockers with both modes. Torbran's +2 counts on Brallin's commander damage, not on Shabraz's.

With Torbran out, cast Razorkin Needlehead ({R}{R}) in the main phase you wheel, then Wheel of Fortune, Reforge the Soul or Magus of the Wheel. Stack 011: 21 per seat. From 40 that leaves 19: cast it when every seat is at 21 or less, or when commander damage follows the same turn.

With Consecrated Sphinx and both commanders out, cast Wheel of Fortune precombat. Stack 009: 49 cards drawn, Shabraz 52/52, and the cleanup discard of 42 fires Brallin past 40 at every seat. If Thought Vessel is on the battlefield, destroy it first with Prismari Command, or remove it with Chaos Warp or Otawara's channel; with Vessel out there is no cleanup discard. Decline Sphinx triggers before your library runs out.
Wait a turn if a blue seat has mana open and you have neither Grand Abolisher out nor a counter in hand, or if the count is short and nothing in hand adds the last point.

optics: Until a commander has counters, the table sees a loot deck with Treasure and ranks you low.
The first symmetrical wheel changes that. The table split on it in 001 (log:001).
Smothering Tithe and Rhystic Study tax every seat. Once a seat pays for both, it is treating you as the threat.
Torbran beside Razorkin Needlehead reads as the wheel kill: each opponent's draw step costs them 3, and the table aims the next removal at Torbran.
Consecrated Sphinx beside Brallin is the stack 009 board. Expect it to draw the next removal spell.
At a table that steps up to bracket 4 you are the slow deck, not the threat (log:002, log:006).
reveal: Hold Akroma's Will for the attack. Blade Historian goes down the turn of the swing, not earlier.
Hold Razorkin Needlehead until the wheel turn. On the battlefield early it is a 2-mana creature that tells every seat the wheel is aimed at them.
Hold Shark Typhoon as a cycle, not a cast. A six-mana enchantment is a removal target; a cycle at the end of the turn before yours is a Shark nobody saw coming.
Put Torbran, Gratuitous Violence and Fiery Emancipation down on the turn the wheel or the attack follows, or when Idyllic Tutor has a second target to find.
Cast Consecrated Sphinx when Wheel of Fortune follows on your next turn, or behind Grand Abolisher.
Pass with zero mana open when Flawless Maneuver or Deflecting Swat is the shield. Both are free while you control a commander.
alliances: Offer removal, not wheels. Swords to Plowshares or Get Lost on another seat's problem buys a rotation.
Brallin's pings hit every opponent on every discard. Do not promise a seat a pass you break with your next loot.
Aim Gleaming Splendor's second draw at the seat you want on your side.
When a seat asks you to stop wheeling, agree and loot instead, and keep the one wheel you need for the kill (log:002).
Break a deal only on the turn the commander damage or the wheel kills.
targets: Commander damage goes at one seat until it dies. A seat at 14 from Shabraz takes the next 7 from Shabraz, not from Brallin.
First, the seat with no flyer or reach to block Shabraz, or no untapped blocker for an unblockable Brallin.
Next, the combo seat. Games 002 and 006 ended on one (log:002, log:006).
The fast seat before the control seat when its board races you: Tannuk in 004, Goblin Storm in 005 (log:004, log:005).
Never the seat holding open blue mana when you have neither Grand Abolisher out nor a counter in hand.
